title: Roster stream handling: optimistic dispatch insert not deduped against SSE delta; fixed 750ms reconnect with no backoff
wanted_capability: (a) D7: dispatching from the roster briefly shows a DOUBLE ENTRY for the new agent — optimistic local insert races the /control/roster/stream RosterDelta carrying the same task; dedup by task_id (or skip optimistic insert when the subscription will deliver it). Look at dispatch_current_input/dispatch_fleet_prompt local insert vs update_task_from_roster in bro-fleet-client. (b) D6: roster_subscription_loop reconnect (fleet.rs ~1667) uses a fixed 750ms sleep, no exponential backoff — reconnect spray if the daemon is down >750ms. Display-only, self-correcting symptoms; same root smell as the zoom-view gap (optimistic local state vs authoritative daemon stream).
notes: D7+D6 from thread-4719ad45. D7 LIVE-CONFIRMED 2026-06-11 via tmux MCP probe: immediately after dispatching agent 24cc2d4b the roster rendered TWO identical rows ("Active (2)", "2 agents", both `ls -la` 1s); ~4s later it reconciled to one row ("Active (1)") — exactly the optimistic-insert-vs-SSE-delta race described. D6 (fixed 750ms reconnect, no backoff) remains code-verified only (fleet.rs ~1667); inducing a live daemon outage to observe reconnect spray was judged disproportionate.
